plugin.name: SteamView
plugin.tagline: Live media preview for the highlighted game

settings.enabledDescription: Show a media preview for the highlighted game.
settings.triggerAutoDescription: The preview appears on its own once a game stays highlighted.
settings.triggerViewButtonDescription: Press View on a highlighted game to show its preview. Press View again, or move to another game, to hide it.
settings.triggerViewButtonUnavailable: This version of Steam does not let plugins read the View button, so no preview will appear in this mode. Switch back to Automatically.
settings.previewDelayDescription: How long a game must stay highlighted before the preview appears. Applies in every mode. Lower values fetch more while scrolling.
settings.previewDelayViewMode: Not used with View: the preview appears as soon as you press it.
settings.autoplayDelayDescription: Extra wait before the trailer starts, once the preview is showing. Trailer mode only.
settings.mutedDescription: Strongly recommended. Steam's own UI sounds keep playing underneath.
settings.loopDescription: Repeat the trailer while the game stays highlighted.
settings.dynamicPositionDescription: Move the preview to the opposite side of the screen from the highlighted game, so it never covers what you are looking at.
settings.dataSaverDescription: Skip video entirely and show screenshots only.
settings.languageDescription: Language for the title, description and genres shown under the preview.
settings.languageAutoUnknown: Following Steam. Steam did not report a language, so English is used.
settings.clearCacheDescription: Delete cached media metadata. Use this if a preview looks wrong or stale.

status.focusUnavailableBody: SteamView could not hook into the library UI, most likely because a SteamOS update changed it. Your library is unaffected. Please report this with the plugin version and your SteamOS build.
status.overlayMissingBody: Decky Loader has not started SteamView's preview layer, so nothing can appear over the library. Most often this means Decky Loader needs updating: Steam's September 2026 update broke versions before 3.2.9. Update Decky Loader, then restart Steam.
